text: - Thank you. The board will now make a motion to go into closed, a closed meeting on March 3rd, 2026, to discuss contract matters pursuant to section 2.2-3711 A29 of the Code of Virginia, personnel matters pursuant to section 2.2-3711 A1 and A3, or I'm sorry, A1, and to consult with legal counsel regarding matters requiring the provision of legal advice by such counsel pursuant to section 2.2-3711 A7 and A3, of the Code of Virginia, specifically contracts
and personnel matters, do I have a motion? Ms. Lady, second, Mr. McElveen. All those in favor, that's unanimous for all board members present. We are adjourned as of 10:41 and we will go into closed.
